Maintainer reference

Planning, verification history and launch research live here so the user documentation can focus on using Oriel. These documents are reference material, not prerequisites for running the app.

Product and verification

  • Build status: observed capabilities, limitations and reproducible checks.
  • Verification history: revision-specific records and earlier checks.
  • Goal and acceptance contract: required gates and retained verification history.
  • Customer 360 plan: intended experience and implementation stages.
  • Customer 360 foundation: identity, snapshots, mappings and evidence contracts.
  • Live validation plan: scope required before making authenticated vendor claims.
  • Roadmap and build charter: priorities and longer-term constraints.
  • Connector implementation goal and runtime proposal: connector design history.

Launch and positioning

  • GTM plan: audience, activation and evidence standards.
  • Launch kit: announcement drafts and demo preparation.
  • Release notes: implemented behavior and limitations.
  • Source provenance: reused components and licenses.

Evaluation research

Comparative evaluations are deferred. These documents preserve research design and historical experiments; they do not establish an accuracy, cost or latency advantage over MCP.

  • Rystic example and comparison design

  • Sequential study and accounting
